title: Tier E live whole-drain measurement correction
historical_measurement_defect: The historical component reader called System.nanoTime inside every record-loop subphase. Its component totals include measurement overhead and are not valid optimization evidence.

correction.implementation: BpfRingBufferReader has no benchmark-only per-record timing path. TierEbpfEngine returns the normal owned drain; TierEProfilerSession measures one complete drain boundary outside the loop and counts ready records from the returned owned event list.
correction.subphase_semantics: ring_scan_ns, ring_decode_ns, ring_append_ns, and ring_consumer_publish_ns are zero because they are unmeasured, not because their work is free.

interpretation: The live whole-drain boundary remains microsecond-scale after removal of intrusive timers, while the deterministic mapped reader is nanosecond-scale. The remaining gap is not attributed to allocation, lock waits, publication, or transport by this artifact; it requires a real-BPF-map control before optimization.
